plain_description.what: Trees were built while reserving different shares of the questions (0.1% to 40%) for the arena. It checks how many leaves and certified splits survive, and whether simulated per-anchor rankings stay precise enough.
plain_description.why: It looks for how much data can go to evaluation without weakening tree construction, a cost trade-off.
plain_description.information: It tells which split ratio balances evaluation precision and tree quality. Result: done (zero calls). The prediction that 30% is the sweet spot was not supported; the readout pointed to 20% (an extended run said 10%). 30% stays the deployed, defensible middle. Leaves grow with training size, but certified splits plateau, limited by the minimum cluster size, not data volume. Leaf-level rankings are not supported at any ratio.
